caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object composed primarily of a large central sphere intersected horizontally by a cylindrical rod that extends through its diameter and projects beyond the sphere on both sides. The sphere and rod assembly is mounted atop a curved, elongated base that resembles a hollow, shallow trough with angled supports at each end for stability. The main object is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. To the upper left of the main illustration, there are four technical sketches: a top view of the base, a side view of the base with supports, a circular top view of the sphere intersected by the rod, and a cross-sectional sketch of the assembly showing the alignment of the rod through the sphere. A small scale is also included for measurement reference in the lower left corner of the technical sketches. The drawing is signed "H. BADER" in the lower right corner. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, likely off-white or beige.
title: Coffee Grinder
